notes: Hydronic pump point dictionary (reference ch.15, PMP-FC-050/051). Loop-agnostic: the same four points serve CHW, HW, and condenser-water pumps; owning equipment is brick:Pump (verified in Brick 1.4.4; use the loop-specific subclass at binding time if the site model has one). The reference states no_flow/deadhead thresholds as percent-of-design; the rules carry absolute-unit parameters, so binding a site means converting design flow/head into the loop's own units first — the same site-specific placeholder discipline as VAV-FC-050's ventilation_requirement.

points.name: pump_cmd

s223.pattern: EnumeratedActuatableProperty on the Pump via hasProperty

points.notes: brick:Start_Stop_Command grep-verified in Brick 1.4.4, attached via isPointOf to brick:Pump (verified). Reference Haystack markers: pump, cmd. Consumed by PMP-FC-050's command conjunct.

points.name: pump_status
points.description: Pump run status feedback (true = proven running)

s223.pattern: EnumeratedObservableProperty on the Pump via hasProperty

points.notes: brick:Pump_On_Off_Status grep-verified in Brick 1.4.4 (pump-specific status class exists, unlike the compressor case). Reference Haystack markers: pump, run. Typical source is a current switch or VFD run feedback; PMP-FC-050 requires BOTH cmd and status true, so a failed status sensor reads as NO_EVAL at the host, not as a fault.

points.name: pump_flow

s223.pattern: QuantifiableObservableProperty on the Pump's discharge segment via hasProperty

points.notes: brick:Water_Flow_Sensor grep-verified in Brick 1.4.4. Reference Haystack markers: water, flow, sensor. The reference's no_flow_threshold (5% of design) and deadhead_flow_threshold (10% of design) are percent-of-design; rules ship absolute L/s placeholders that MUST be set from the loop's design flow at binding.

points.name: pump_dp
points.description: Pump differential pressure (discharge minus suction, or loop DP where that is what the site trends)

s223.pattern: QuantifiableObservableProperty across the Pump via hasProperty

points.notes: brick:Water_Differential_Pressure_Sensor grep-verified in Brick 1.4.4, but marked provisional because sites trend this two ways — across the pump (deadhead reads HIGH) or across the loop/decoupler (deadhead may read high or low depending on tap location). PMP-FC-051's logic assumes the ACROSS-THE-PUMP reading; binding a loop-DP point instead inverts the diagnosis and must be caught at binding review. deadhead_dp_threshold (150% of design head) ships as an absolute kPa placeholder.
